### Reference: testing

#### `ModelRecording`

const, type · `import { ModelRecording } from '@harness/sdk/testing'`

A recording of a real model's replies, one per chat forward, in order.

```ts
type ModelRecording = {
  replies: ({
    type: "chunk";
    chunk: {
      content?: string | undefined;
      reasoning?: string | undefined;
      toolCallNamed?: {
        id: string;
        name: string;
        arguments: string;
      } | undefined;
      toolCallArguments?: {
        id: string;
        name: string;
        arguments: string;
      } | undefined;
      toolCallMore?: {
        id: string;
        name: string;
        arguments: string;
      } | undefined;
      toolCall?: {
        id: string;
        name: string;
        arguments: string;
      } | undefined;
      finishReason?: "refusal" | "length" | "stop" | "tool_calls" | "content_filter" | undefined;
      refusal?: string | undefined;
      usage?: {
        input: number;
        output: number;
        cached?: number | undefined;
        reasoning?: number | undefined;
      } | undefined;
    };
  } | {
    type: "descriptors";
    tools: Record<string, string>;
    output?: string | undefined;
  } | {
    type: "done";
    usage: {
      input: number;
      output: number;
      cached?: number | undefined;
      reasoning?: number | undefined;
    };
    cost: number;
    interaction: string;
    model: string;
  } | {
    type: "error";
    message: string;
    kind: "provider" | "limit" | "model" | "tool";
  })[][];
};
```

Refers to: [`LlmForwardChunk`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.llm-ts#core-llmforwardchunk).

#### `realModel`

const · `import { realModel } from '@harness/sdk/testing'`

A real free model (OpenRouter, `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`; the models of `HARNESS_LIVE_MODEL` and
`HARNESS_LIVE_FALLBACKS`). `realModel.it` declares a test that calls it: marked `real`, skipped without a key.

```ts
const realModel: { link(): OpenRouterModelLink | undefined; available(): boolean; it(name: string, body: RealModelTest, timeout?: number): void; };
```

#### `liveTurn`

function · `import { liveTurn } from '@harness/sdk/testing'`

A run's time for a call that drives a real model through an agent (authoring a fn): four minutes, like a turn on the
hub (`HARNESS_TURN_TIME`, ten minutes by default), not the test hub's 60-second default, which a real model writing
and checking a program can pass without anything being wrong. Pass it as `kit.call`'s extra.

```ts
function liveTurn(ms?: number): { deadline: number; budget: { cost: number; time: number; limitedBy: "turn"; }; };
```

#### `OpenRouterModelLink`

class · `import { OpenRouterModelLink } from '@harness/sdk/testing'`

A `ModelLink` that runs forwarded chat requests on free OpenRouter models. Only chat: other modalities are refused.

```ts
class OpenRouterModelLink implements ModelLink {
  /** Every chat forward, in order. */
  readonly forwards: LlmForward[];
  /** The model that answered each forward, in order. */
  readonly answeredBy: string[];
  constructor(options: OpenRouterOptions);
  llm(forward: LlmForward, signal?: AbortSignal): AsyncGenerator<LlmForwardChunk>;
  model(forward: ModelForward): Promise<ModelForwardResult>;
  models(): Promise<HubModelInfo[]>;
  connected(): boolean;
}
```

#### `OpenRouterOptions`

interface · `import { OpenRouterOptions } from '@harness/sdk/testing'`

How an `OpenRouterModelLink` calls.

```ts
interface OpenRouterOptions {

  readonly key: string;

  readonly models: readonly string[];
```

#### `preview`

function · `import { preview } from '@harness/sdk/testing'`

Preview a component in its states. Without shooting, it bundles the component once to prove it builds and returns
no shots; with shooting, every state, viewport and theme is saved and returned.

```ts
function preview(options: PreviewOptions): Promise<SavedShot[]>;
```

#### `PreviewOptions`

interface · `import { PreviewOptions } from '@harness/sdk/testing'`

What to preview: one component, from its module, in named states.

```ts
interface PreviewOptions {
  /** The component's name as the client registers it (a renderer's type, a visual's entry, an input, an editor). */
  readonly name: string;
  /** The module that exports it: a `.vue` file or a module, as a path or `new URL('./X.vue', import.meta.url)`. */
  readonly module: string | URL;
  /** Its export (default `default`). */
  readonly export?: string;
  /** Props by state name: the kit's `empty`, `loading`, `error`, `typical`, `long`, or names of its own. Plain JSON. */
  readonly states: Readonly<Record<string, JsonObject>>;
  /** Default both. */
  readonly viewports?: readonly PreviewViewport[];
  /** Default both. */
  readonly themes?: readonly PreviewTheme[];
  /** Force shooting on or off (default `HARNESS_PREVIEWS`). */
  readonly shoot?: boolean;
}
```

Refers to: [`JsonObject`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.primitives-ts#core-jsonobject), [`PreviewViewport`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.checks-ts#core-previewviewport).

#### `ScratchFolder`

interface · `import { ScratchFolder } from '@harness/sdk/testing'`

A scratch folder: its path, file helpers, git, and removal.

```ts
interface ScratchFolder {
  readonly dir: string;
  /** Write a file (folders made as needed). */
  write(path: string, text: string | Uint8Array): void;
  read(path: string): string;
  remove(path: string): void;
  /** Run git in the folder; its output. Throws when git fails. */

}
```

#### `ScratchOptions`

interface · `import { ScratchOptions } from '@harness/sdk/testing'`

#### `FakeRecords`

class · `import { FakeRecords } from '@harness/sdk/testing'`

Records of stored types in memory, answered like the hub's data endpoints.

```ts
class FakeRecords {
  /** Every record, by id, in the order saved. */
  readonly records: Map<string, { id: string; type: `${string}/${string}`; value: JSONType; title: string; version: number; createdAt: number; updatedAt: number; owner?: string | undefined; updatedBy?: string | undefined; updatedBySystem?: (string & $brand<"SystemName">) | undefined; run?: string | undefined; }>;
  /** Every version written, oldest first. */
  readonly versions: RecordVersion[];
  /** `types` finds a stored type's declaration (the system's manifest); `owner` is the person a run acts for. */
  constructor(types: (name: QualifiedName) => StoredTypeDecl | undefined, owner: () => ActorId);
  /** The records of one type, newest change first (what a test reads back). */
  of(type: QualifiedName): DataRecord[];
  find(query: RecordQuery): RecordPage;
  get(body: RecordGet): { record?: DataRecord; };
  table(body: RecordTableQuery): ResultTable;
  save(body: RecordSave, time?: number): DataRecord;
  remove(body: RecordRemove, time?: number): { removed: boolean; };
}
```
